scope: Historical audit of the original futuretwin_distilbert.zip only. Active v2 provenance is checkpoint-bound and verified separately; see DISTILBERT-V2.md.

research_reference.title: GPTs are GPTs: An Early Look at the Labor Market Impact Potential of Large Language Models

definitions.E0: No or minimal qualifying time reduction at equivalent quality, or quality falls.
definitions.E1: LLM alone can reduce completion time by at least 50% while maintaining quality.
definitions.E2: LLM alone does not meet the threshold, but complementary LLM-powered software could.

research_reference.e3_note: The paper annotated image-related E3 separately and combined it into E2 for analysis. The checkpoint's training preprocessing is not supplied.
research_reference.interpretation: Potential task exposure under a time-saving rubric, not job replacement; E2 is not more dangerous than E1.

dataset.note: Multiple distinct annotation targets exist. Matching class-code names does not identify which target, if any, trained this checkpoint.

local_audit.contents: Configuration, weights, tokenizer and training_args.bin; no labelled dataset, model card or training/generation script.
local_audit.training_args_policy: Pickle artifact was not executed or unpickled.
local_audit.other_training_data: Existing anchor/positive sentence-pair files train MiniLM, not the E0/E1/E2 classifier.
local_audit.result: No verifiable link from uploaded checkpoint to the paper's annotation dataset or label-generation process.

missing_evidence: Original DistilBERT training notebook/script and labelled dataset or immutable dataset revision.
Selected target column and exact label-to-index transformation.
Handling of E3, missing labels, aggregation and any synthetic/relabelled examples.
